name: John Feldmann
description: '''John William Feldmann''' (born 1967) is an American musician, singer-songwriter and record producer. He serves as the lead singer/guitarist of the punk rock band [[Goldfinger (band)|Goldfinger]]. Feldman has written and produced for many acts including [[Good Charlotte]], [[All Time Low]], [[The Used]], [[Panic! At The Disco]], [[blink-182]], [[FEVER 333]], [[Beartooth]], [[Biffy Clyro]], [[Korn]] and [[311 (band)|311]].
